tasks.short: Write and review purchase specifications with technical owners, using current requirements and product knowledge.

steps.what: Clarify operating needs, constraints and acceptance criteria with the requester.
Find previous specifications, technical manuals and relevant standards in the {DOCS}.
Draft the specification, including performance requirements, interfaces and acceptance tests.

loop.input: Requirements brief, approved template and versioned technical source pack.
loop.output: Draft specification with source references, acceptance criteria and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Check required sections and numeric consistency. Require a source for technical claims; flag unsupported requirements.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass per specification; unresolved sections remain blank for technical review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates structure the document, but varied technical prose needs contextual synthesis.

steps.what: Review feasibility, safety, compatibility and acceptance tests; resolve technical gaps.
Approve the specification for use in supplier enquiries.
File the approved version and attach it to the sourcing record in the {PROCUREMENT}.

tasks.design: Configure a versioned requirements form and source library in the {DOCS}, linked to sourcing records in the {PROCUREMENT}. A bounded drafting loop fills an approved specification template and flags unsupported requirements; the technical owner reviews and approves release. Approval triggers filing and attachment of the approved version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical requirements sit across manuals, previous purchases and expert knowledge. Templates help, but someone still assembles the first draft.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document controls handle retrieval and versioning. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of connecting records, while a bounded model can assemble a source-linked draft.
tasks.still_hard: Compatibility, safety and testability require technical expertise. Standards access and document version quality can be expensive to maintain.
tasks.human_edge: Translate an operating problem into a testable requirement and recognise when a technically plausible specification would fail in practice.

ambition.what: A reusable acceptance-test pack for recurring equipment purchases.

tasks.altitude: The purchasing agent spends less time assembling documents and more time testing requirements with users and technical owners. They can propose acceptance criteria earlier; technical approval rights remain with the technical owner.

reach.task: Maintain approved specification versions and attach the correct version to supplier enquiries.
reach.learn: Document control, source provenance and specification change handling.

reach.task: Challenge specifications that unnecessarily restrict supplier competition.
reach.learn: Functional requirements, acceptance testing and whole-life cost.

evidence.claim: Versioned templates, required fields and approval routing can handle specification administration deterministically.
A bounded model can draft from technical documents, but feasibility and acceptance criteria still need expert review.

assumptions: This describes a typical mixed equipment and services purchasing role, rather than specialist engineering design.
Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured results.
Approved technical documents can be indexed using existing permissions.
Build ranges cover a narrow initial deployment and active working days; external waiting time is additional.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply to the deployment; access and retention controls cover any personal data in source documents.
unknowns: Who has authority to approve technical specifications?
Are current standards, manuals and previous specifications available in searchable form?
Can the {DOCS} and {PROCUREMENT} link approved versions without duplicate uploads?
Which purchases require specialist safety or regulatory review?
research_questions: Which machine-readable specification formats best preserve requirements, units and acceptance tests?
How reliably can source-linked drafting detect contradictions across technical documents?
new_work: Maintain approved templates, source versions and retrieval tags.
Resolve unsupported requirements and conflicting source documents.
Sample drafts for omitted constraints and misleading source references.
Maintain links between released specifications and sourcing records.

tasks.short: Compare supplier proposals and financial evidence to establish a defensible price position.

steps.what: Retrieve purchase history, contracted prices and supplier financial data from the {ERP} and {PROCUREMENT}.
Read supplier quotations and financial reports for prices, conditions and cost drivers.

loop.input: Supplier quotations and financial reports with document dates and source identifiers.
loop.output: Source-linked prices, units, currencies, exclusions, validity dates and financial observations.
loop.check: Validate schema, totals and currencies; require page references and flag missing or ambiguous terms.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per document; unresolved fields are flagged for the buyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Supplier documents vary in layout and express exclusions and commercial conditions in free text.

steps.what: Normalise units, currencies, delivery costs and payment terms in a comparison workbook.
Challenge assumptions and unusual price differences with the technical owner or finance team.
Set and record a reasonable price range and negotiation position.

tasks.design: A scheduled integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines purchase history from the {ERP} with quotations and contract prices from the {PROCUREMENT}. A bounded extraction loop produces source-linked terms, and deterministic calculations feed a comparison in the {BI}. The purchasing agent resolves flagged assumptions and approves the price position before it supports negotiation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Historic prices, quotation conditions and financial evidence are difficult to compare. Bespoke workbooks often contain undocumented assumptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Connectors and tested calculation libraries handle structured comparisons. Bounded document extraction reduces rekeying while retaining the original evidence.
tasks.still_hard: A reasonable price depends on market conditions, specification differences, supplier economics and bargaining power. Financial reports can be stale and do not reveal a supplier's true cost.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a justified premium from weak competition, hidden exclusions or an unrealistic offer.

ambition.what: Monthly target-price reviews for critical raw materials.

tasks.altitude: The purchasing agent spends more time investigating price drivers and preparing negotiation options. They gain a stronger basis to propose target prices; spending and contract authority do not change.

reach.task: Set negotiation priorities across categories using comparable price evidence.
reach.learn: Price decomposition, sensitivity analysis and the difference between price savings and cost avoidance.

reach.task: Resolve missing units, currencies and quotation validity dates.
reach.learn: Quotation terminology, evidence traceability and exception handling.

evidence.claim: Transporeon checks carrier invoices against agreed rates, demonstrating a narrow deterministic rate-comparison capability.
Unit conversion, currency conversion and total-cost calculations can use explicit formulas and dated assumptions.
Document extraction can prepare a comparison, while determining reasonable prices still requires commercial judgement.

assumptions: The purchasing agent recommends prices within an existing delegation framework.
Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured results.
Missing or ambiguous terms prevent a quotation from being presented as fully comparable.
Calculations distinguish recoverable taxes from genuine purchase costs and use dated exchange-rate assumptions.
Build ranges cover one category initially and active working days; external waiting time is additional.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply; supplier contacts and confidential commercial data retain appropriate access controls.
unknowns: Which purchase-history fields and quotation documents are accessible?
Who approves exchange rates, financing assumptions and whole-life cost inputs?
Which currencies, units and pricing structures occur most often?
What authority does the purchasing agent have to set negotiation positions?
Are external financial data licensed for automated processing?
research_questions: Which quotation terms most often make automated price comparisons misleading?
What validation methods best detect extraction errors in tiered and conditional pricing?
new_work: Maintain conversion tables, cost formulas and dated comparison assumptions.
Review missing terms and unusual calculated differences.
Check extraction quality against original quotations.

tasks.short: Help hire purchasing staff, organise training and supervise clerks, buyers and expediters.

steps.what: Agree staffing needs, role requirements and hiring approval with the purchasing manager.
Register the vacancy and coordinate candidate interviews through the {ATS} and {CALENDAR}.
Interview candidates, assess practical skills and approve the selection decision.
Prepare practical training guides and exercises from purchasing procedures in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Approved purchasing procedures, role requirements and training templates; no candidate or employee assessments.
loop.output: Source-linked training guide and exercises using fictional purchasing cases.
loop.check: Verify procedure references, approval limits and answer keys; the purchasing agent approves use.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per guide; unresolved procedural conflicts go to the procedure owner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure, but explaining procedures and writing realistic exercises requires varied prose.

steps.what: Assign courses, book practice sessions and track completion in the {LMS}.
Coach staff, allocate difficult work and discuss performance or support needs.
Record agreed development actions and formal review outcomes in the {TALENT}.

tasks.design: Configure vacancy administration and scheduling in the {ATS} and {CALENDAR}, plus role-based course assignment in the {LMS}. A bounded loop drafts training materials from approved procedures in the {DOCS}; structured action forms feed the {TALENT} after supervisor approval. Interviews, hiring decisions, coaching and formal performance judgements remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scheduling, training materials and development records are spread across different systems. Supervisors often repeat administrative work because those systems are only partly configured or connected.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduling, enrolment and form features can remove repeated administration. A small drafting loop can turn approved procedures into reviewable training materials.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing potential, building trust and handling poor performance require sustained human involvement. Employee data access, retention and consultation require deployment-specific review under GDPR, the EU AI Act and national rules.
tasks.human_edge: Notice why someone is struggling, give fair feedback and make accountable hiring and development decisions.

ambition.what: A supervised practice clinic for junior buyers handling their first supplier dispute.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor has more time for observed practice and individual coaching. They can propose structured development paths; hiring, pay and disciplinary authority remain as delegated today.

reach.task: Plan team capacity and succession from workload and demonstrated skills.
reach.learn: Capacity planning, structured interviews and fair development assessment.

reach.task: Coordinate approved training assignments and maintain completion records.
reach.learn: Learning administration, employee-data access and escalation boundaries.

evidence.claim: Scheduling, course assignment and structured development records can use existing system configuration.
Drafting training materials from approved procedures can reduce preparation work without automating employee assessment.
Hiring interviews, coaching and performance decisions depend on interpersonal judgement and accountable supervision.

assumptions: The purchasing agent has delegated supervisory duties; otherwise the purchasing manager performs the supervisory steps.
This composite task includes occasional recruitment and recurring training and supervision; not every step occurs each week.
Time shares span that mix of work and include recruiter handoffs; they are planning estimates.
Hiring decisions are supplied to the existing recruitment process; offer preparation is outside this task.
Training assignment follows a previously approved role curriculum.
Development records use structured, human-authored inputs rather than automatic meeting transcription or employee scoring.
Consent and access estimates include HR review and works-council or employee consultation where national rules require it; statutory waiting time is additional.
No model ranks candidates or evaluates employees. Any later expansion requires a separate GDPR and EU AI Act assessment.
unknowns: Does this role actually supervise staff or only support the purchasing manager?
Which recruitment, learning and performance systems are already configured?
What hiring and formal review authority is delegated?
Which national consultation requirements and employee agreements apply?
Are role-based curricula and approved purchasing procedures current?
research_questions: Which structured practice exercises best reveal readiness for procurement responsibilities?
Which configuration patterns connect learning and development records while minimising employee-data duplication?
new_work: Review generated guides, exercises and answer keys.
Maintain role curricula and procedure references.
Check employee-data permissions and retention settings.
Audit that configuration changes do not introduce automated employee scoring.

tasks.short: Research suppliers, compare capability and performance evidence, and recommend a defensible shortlist.

steps.what: Retrieve supplier records, purchase history and delivery or quality performance.
Read supplier questionnaires, certificates and capability documents against the purchase requirement.

loop.input: Supplier questionnaires, certificates and capability documents with source and date metadata.
loop.output: Evidence table of capabilities, service commitments, certificate dates and unresolved claims.
loop.check: Require source references; distinguish supplier claims from independently verified facts and flag expired evidence.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per document; unresolved or contradictory claims go to the buyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Capability evidence uses varied prose and document layouts that fixed field mappings cannot reliably cover.

steps.what: Compare price, quality, delivery and service evidence in a supplier scorecard.
Discuss capability gaps with suppliers and verify references or production arrangements.
Judge trade-offs and approve the recommended supplier shortlist.
Record assessment status, evidence links and review dates in the {PROCUREMENT}.

tasks.design: An integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines supplier records from the {PROCUREMENT} with purchase, delivery and quality history from the {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. A bounded loop structures documents in the {DOCS}, while deterministic checks and scorecards expose missing, stale or conflicting evidence in the {BI}. The purchasing agent verifies material claims, approves the shortlist and triggers updates and review reminders in the {PROCUREMENT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplier evidence is fragmented and mixes sales claims with observed performance. Comparable scorecards require repeated collection and manual interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records and integrations can supply repeatable performance measures. Bounded extraction can organise varied documents without claiming to verify their truth.
tasks.still_hard: Reputation, resilience and real production capacity are difficult to establish from documents. New suppliers lack internal performance history, and reference checks or site visits remain costly.
tasks.human_edge: Probe weak evidence, test supplier credibility and balance price against operational dependence and service risk.

ambition.what: First-time suppliers with limited trading history through a structured pilot-qualification route.

tasks.altitude: The purchasing agent spends more time verifying critical capabilities and designing limited supplier trials. They can propose alternative suppliers earlier; contract award and supplier activation rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Decide where supplier concentration warrants a qualified alternative.
reach.learn: Supply continuity, concentration measures and the limits of weighted scorecards.

reach.task: Maintain supplier evidence, expiry dates and review status.
reach.learn: Evidence provenance, certificate validation and supplier-record controls.

reach.task: Compare supplier assortment and service capability against category needs.
reach.learn: Separate operational capability evidence from commercial claims.

evidence.claim: Supplier scorecards and evidence-expiry checks can use deterministic records, formulas and reminders.
Bounded extraction can structure supplier documents but cannot establish whether capability claims are true.
Supplier selection requires contextual judgement because price, quality, continuity and service trade-offs vary by purchase.

assumptions: The purchasing agent recommends a shortlist; this task does not include contract award or bank-detail changes.
Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured results.
Evaluation criteria are approved before suppliers are compared.
Missing evidence remains visible and is not silently scored as poor performance.
New supplier evidence is assessed separately from incumbent transaction history.
Build ranges cover one supplier category and active working days; external waiting time is additional.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply. Personal contact data and any sole-trader assessment require appropriate access, retention and decision safeguards.
Supplier-document content is treated as evidence, never as instructions controlling the workflow.
unknowns: Can delivery and quality records be reliably joined to supplier identifiers?
Which supplier evidence is already collected and independently checked?
Who approves evaluation criteria and supplier shortlists?
Which categories require site visits or specialist qualification?
Are supplier performance measures used to assess employees, triggering consultation considerations under national rules?
Can the {PROCUREMENT} store evidence versions and schedule reviews?
research_questions: Which evidence most reliably predicts supplier delivery and service failures in each category?
How should qualification methods compare new suppliers with incumbents without penalising missing trading history?
new_work: Maintain supplier identifier mappings and performance definitions.
Review extracted claims, stale evidence and conflicting documents.
Maintain evaluation criteria and examine sensitivity to score weights.
Verify important capability claims through references, trials or visits.
Monitor supplier review reminders and connector failures.

role.altitude: The purchasing agent moves from assembling documents and comparisons toward requirements challenge, commercial analysis and supplier verification. The change strengthens recommendations; formal technical, spending and employment decision rights remain with their existing owners unless explicitly delegated.
reach: Support the purchasing manager with target-price reviews and supplier continuity options.
Help procurement clerks manage evidence quality and exceptions across sourcing records.
Exchange supplier capability and service evidence with wholesale and retail buyers.
skills_to_grow: Write testable functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
Interpret total-cost calculations and challenge their assumptions.
Verify supplier evidence and assess operational resilience.
Understand data lineage, access controls and bounded model limitations.
Coach purchasing staff through practical cases.
role.ambitious_version: Run an evidence-backed sourcing advisory service that gives internal requesters clear specifications, defensible price ranges and qualified supplier alternatives before negotiations begin.

job.title: Purchasing Agents, Except Wholesale, Retail, and Farm Products
